'''Mountain Home''' was an underground facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]] that was used as a base of operations by the [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Rangers]] and other Toprawan rebels during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Mountain Home housed the rebels [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay facilities and the base was connected to the resistance outpost [[Foothill]] via a series of subterranean tunnels.
